import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Manitoba, Canada bounding box (approximate)
manitoba = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-102, 49, -89, 60])  # [W, S, E, N]

# Date: August 3, 2025
date = '2025-08-03'
start_date = ee.Date(date)
end_date = start_date.advance(1, 'day')  # Single day

# 2. Data Acquisition - Try VIIRS fire data first
fire_collection = ee.FeatureCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGMT') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(manitoba)

# Check collection size
collection_size = fire_collection.size().getInfo()
print(f"VIIRS Fire detections on {date}: {collection_size}")

# If empty, try MODIS as fallback
if collection_size == 0:
    print("Trying MODIS as fallback...")
    fire_collection = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/061/MCD14DL') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(manitoba)
    
    collection_size = fire_collection.size().getInfo()
    print(f"MODIS Fire detections on {date}: {collection_size}")

# 3. Handle missing data (Case 1)
if collection_size == 0:
    print(f"No fire data available for {date}.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 4. Process valid data
    # Count is already available from size()
    fire_count = collection_size
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    print(f"Fire count: {fire_count}")
    
    # Check if count is valid (not None/NaN)
    if fire_count is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif fire_count > 30:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
